title: CameraDistance 2.7: bow zoom limit
intro: Reset Scripts first (CameraDistance 2.7.0). Then in the menu: Camera Distance > Couch Co-op Framing > tick 'Limit the bow-aim zoom so player 2 stays in view'. Close the menu, press End.

steps.text: The main pawn right next to the Arisen's aim line: aim the bow. Zoom should look normal. Press End while aiming or after
The main pawn 5-10 m off to one side, in front: aim the bow. Does the zoom ease off to keep him in? Press End
Aim, and have the main pawn run across in front. Smooth or jumpy? Press End
The main pawn behind the Arisen: aim. Zoom should be normal with the edge marker. Press End

probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active
probes.pscr: local p=H.pawn(0):call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.ascr: local p=H.arisen():call('get_Transform'):call('get_Position'); local s=draw.world_to_screen(Vector3f.new(p.x,p.y+1.0,p.z)); return s and string.format('%.0f,%.0f',s.x,s.y) or 'off'
probes.aim: local a=H.arisen(); return a:call('get_IsAim') == true or a:call('get_IsShootAim') == true
